description.text: Power every mile with the HOKA Clifton 11 Running Shoes, built for smooth, lightweight performance on daily runs and long distances alike. A breathable engineered mesh upper pairs with a plush CMEVA midsole and smooth MetaRocker™ geometry to deliver soft landings and effortless flow mile after mile. Finished with durable traction and a secure, locked-in fit, it’s designed to keep your runs fast, fluid, and unstoppable. What’s New: Marked by its new upper refresh, the Clifton 11 utilizes an elevated engineered mesh upper and softer, more premium sockliner Design: Engineered mesh upper delivers breathable support for consistent airflow on daily runs 3D printed touchpoints add lightweight structure and targeted durability Reflective details enhance visibility in low-light conditions Double-lace lock system helps secure the fit and reduce lace movement In-Shoe Comfort: Rearfoot-Focused Active Foot Frame™ cradles the heel for added stability and support Smooth MetaRocker™ promotes a natural stride and seamless heel-to-toe transitions Open cell sockliner provides soft step-in comfort with improved breathability CMEVA midsole delivers lightweight cushioning for everyday mileage Durability & Traction: Durabrasion rubber outsole offers reliable grip and long-lasting wear on road surfaces Additional Details: Weight: 9.87 oz / 280g (size 10) Heel drop: 8mm Stack height: 42mm heel / 34mm (size 10) Designed for road running and daily training routines Vegan

reviews.headline: Color is way off
reviews.comments: I purchased the pebble grey/boulder grey. They are anything but grey. They literally are BROWN. The picture does not look like them at all! Other than that, they’re Hokas and i love them but still have to return them because they are NOT grey!

reviews.headline: Super Comfortable but not durable
reviews.comments: I bought these exactly 4 weeks ago. I only used them for running... Not daily use. I literally used them for 11 walk/runs at 5 miles each. I noticed the soles were peeling off on both shoes. My last pair of daily Hokas(Clifton 10) lasted 9 mo.
Very comfortable. Better than the Bonde 8 Jermaine was very helpful in helping me the right show I appreciate all the help he gave me👍👍👌👌

reviews.headline: Over rated
reviews.comments: Not a great shoe as hyped.. Soft cushioning is too soft and leaning inward causing tremendous pressure on knee and calf leading to painful all day shoe..After about a week I have to stop wearing. Warranty service from Hoka sucks when it comes to customer satisfaction.

reviews.headline: Great features!
reviews.comments: I’ve been very happy with these HOKA Clifton 11 running shoes. They are comfortable, lightweight, and provide excellent cushioning and support. They feel great for walking and running, and I really like how they fit and look. The quality is also great, and they’ve quickly become one of my favorite pairs of shoes. Highly recommend them!

reviews.headline: Very comfortable shoes!
reviews.comments: I’ve never purchased HOKA shoes. Great investment! I will buy another pair.

reviews.headline: Great looking shoe
reviews.comments: These are extremely nice looking shoes and i have enjoyed them so far!

reviews.headline: Comfortable
reviews.comments: Last pair of Clifton 10s lasted 6 months in an office environment. Hoping the 11s are better. Shoes are super comfortable, though overpriced.

reviews.headline: Great shoes for walking a lot
reviews.comments: These shoes were suggested from a boyfriend to get used to wearing for a trip to Disney next year. He still getting used to the height difference. But they do not hurt his feet and his legs do not hurt at the end of the day.

reviews.headline: wrong size
reviews.comments: wrong size was sent the shoes were not comfortable
